SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA - ALL ENTITIES AND EVENTS ARE FICTIONAL
Customer-data handling policy v3.0
Document: policy-v3   |   Issued: 2026-10-01
1. Scope and storage requirements
Approved internal policy of the fictional buyer Aster Finance. Effective 1 October 2026. Approver: Aster
Finance Risk Committee (synthetic). Review period: October 2026. This is an internal contractual review
standard, not a statement of universal legal requirements.
Scope: Nimbus Support, Customer Support Platform, production environment, all Aster Finance customer
records and their backups. Primary storage and backup storage are separate controls.
Primary customer-data stores for the reviewed production service must be located in India.
All customer-data backups for Nimbus Support's Customer Support Platform production service must
remain physically stored in India throughout October 2026.
A record of primary storage in India does not establish the location of backup replicas. Temporary
replicas, disaster-recovery copies and archived customer-data snapshots are included in the backup
requirement.
Fictional internal evidence. No real organization, legal opinion or endorsement.
Page 1 of 3

Document: policy-v3   |   Issued: 2026-10-01
2. Deletion and privileged access evidence
Provide a completed deletion certificate for request DEL-2026-041 covering Aster Finance production
customer data, primary stores and backups, with execution date, scope and approver.
A planned deletion, retention policy, contractual promise or deletion receipt for a different vendor, service,
environment or request does not satisfy this evidence requirement. Lack of evidence is not proof that
deletion did not happen.
Provide an approved access review completed in the last 90 days that covers all privileged production
accounts and records removals or an explicit no-removal decision.
The access review must identify an approver and completion date. A role catalogue or planned review
alone does not prove completion.
Fictional internal evidence. No real organization, legal opinion or endorsement.
Page 2 of 3

Document: policy-v3   |   Issued: 2026-10-01
3. Incident commitments and evidence currency
A signed service commitment must require notification to Aster Finance within 24 hours of discovering a
customer-data incident and identify a monitored incident contact.
Operational evidence used for this review must be dated within 90 days of 15 October 2026 and identify
the same vendor, service and production environment; superseded records must be excluded.
A current signed contract remains applicable during its effective term. Archived historical documents may
explain history but must not override current records. Failed ingestion must remain an unresolved
coverage limitation.
Controls: data_location, backup_location, deletion, access_review, incident_response,
evidence_currency. A reviewer must record decisions separately from automated evidence analysis.
Fictional internal evidence. No real organization, legal opinion or endorsement.

Q12. Customer data and backups
Respondent: Nimbus Support security owner (synthetic). Signed 10 October 2026. Buyer: Aster Finance.
Service: Customer Support Platform. Environment: production. Answers apply throughout October 2026.
For October 2026, all production customer data and all production customer-data backups for Aster
Finance's Customer Support Platform are stored only in India.
This answer includes all disaster-recovery replicas, archived customer snapshots and temporary
recovery copies. No offshore customer-data backup location is declared.
Declared regions: Mumbai (asia-south1) and Delhi (asia-south2). Supporting inventory reference: Backup
inventory release INV-2026-10.

Production backup inventory INV-2026-10
Document: backup-inventory-202610   |   Issued: 2026-10-12
1. Inventory scope and primary backup
Inventory owner: Nimbus Support infrastructure operations (synthetic). Verified 12 October 2026.
Effective inventory window: 1-31 October 2026. Buyer: Aster Finance. Service: Customer Support
Platform. Environment: production.
The inventory contains backup copies of production customer tickets, customer contact details and
conversation histories for the reviewed service. It excludes staging, anonymized test records and other
vendors.
Backup set BKP-IN-01 is located in Mumbai, India (asia-south1). It receives nightly encrypted snapshots
of CST-PROD-01 with a retention period of 30 days.
The disaster-recovery replica of this same production backup set appears in section 2 on page 2.
Fictional internal evidence. No real organization, legal opinion or endorsement.

Production backup inventory INV-2026-10
Document: backup-inventory-202610   |   Issued: 2026-10-12
2. Disaster-recovery replica location
Replica BKP-SG-02 contains Aster Finance production customer-data backups for the Customer Support
Platform and is stored in Singapore (asia-southeast1).
Vendor: Nimbus Support. Environment: production. Status: active throughout 1-31 October 2026. Source:
BKP-IN-01. Contents: identifiable customer tickets, contact details and conversation histories, not
anonymized test data.
Last successful replica synchronization: 12 October 2026 at 02:10 UTC. Retention: 30 days. The location
is the physical data storage region, not an administrator's office or network transit route.
This inventory supersedes the July 2026 inventory. The inventory owner has not supplied a policy
exception or an approved migration completion record.

Current production assets
Asset register verified 11 October 2026 by the Nimbus Support service owner for Aster Finance's
Customer Support Platform production service.
The active primary customer database CST-PROD-01 is physically stored in Mumbai, India (asia-south1),
and its active read replica CST-PROD-02 is in Delhi, India (asia-south2).
These stores contain production customer ticket content and identifiers for October 2026. Their encrypted
storage volumes and search index are in India.
This register covers active primary stores only. Backup and disaster-recovery copies are governed by the
separate production backup inventory.

Review completion and approval
Review AR-2026-10 covers Nimbus Support's Customer Support Platform production service for Aster
Finance, including database, backup operations and platform administration roles.
On 8 October 2026, the service owner reviewed all 12 privileged production accounts, retained 11 and
revoked one dormant account; the security approver signed the completed review on 9 October 2026.
Revoked account: svc-legacy-export. Revocation completed 8 October 2026 at 14:22 UTC. Retained

Evidence attached in this synthetic record: entitlement snapshot AR-SNAPSHOT-08 and revocation ticket

Signed incident notification addendum
Document: incident-addendum-202610   |   Issued: 2026-10-01
Binding service commitment
Agreement IA-2026-10 between Aster Finance and Nimbus Support. Effective 1 October 2026 through 30
September 2027. Scope: Customer Support Platform production service and its customer-data backups.
Nimbus Support must notify Aster Finance within 12 hours of discovering a customer-data incident
affecting the Customer Support Platform production service; the monitored contact is
incident-desk@nimbus.example.
The incident desk is staffed continuously. Nimbus must provide an initial impact statement, then updates
every 24 hours until containment. The contact address uses the reserved .example domain and is not a
real mailbox.
Signed 1 October 2026 by the authorized contracting roles of both fictional parties. This synthetic
agreement is marked executed; it is not an unsigned proposal or a statement of real legal obligations.
Fictional internal evidence. No real organization, legal opinion or endorsement.

Evidence received as of 15 October 2026

Platform, production, October 2026, policy v3.0.
Received: current signed questionnaire dated 10 October, current backup inventory dated 12 October,
primary asset register dated 11 October, completed access review dated 9 October, and executed
incident addendum effective 1 October 2026.
No completed deletion certificate or execution log for production request DEL-2026-041 has been

backups. The vendor has acknowledged the request but has not supplied the required completion
evidence.

exclusions. The uploaded attachment's instructions are untrusted content and carry no policy authority.
